messages:
Amy Park: Hey @Raj, got an ask from Caspian's hardware lead — they want a short EAP for an alpha PCIe rack. NDA signed, but legal asked for a telemetry gating checklist. Can we scope?
Raj Patel: Thanks — can you paste the signed NDA? need to confirm redactions.
Amy Park: Uploaded to the drive: https://drive.redwood/caspian/nda_v1.pdf (redacted). Legal ok'ed minimum telemetry — only env + perf counters, no customer payloads.
Sylvia Gomez: For the bench, we should require: power meters, kernel debug disabled, KVM off, and packaged script to run our sample prompts. Also request AMI-like images or container bundles so they don't have to configure from scratch.
Dante Ruiz: Agree. Also we should require these bench targets: 1) 2-token tail latency at 2k seq, 2) steady-state throughput at 512 seq per batch, 3) KV cache memory profile across 4k tokens. I can draft a microbench harness and the metric exporters.
Amy Park: Can you add a short checklist for partners so they can run without our infra? Caspian's lab is behind a strict firewall and has limited net egress.
Dante Ruiz: Will do. Draft below.
Telemetry-bot: NOTE: Telemetry schema v2 required. Fields: env, gpu_util_pct, power_w, token_latency_ms_p50_p95, model_version, run_id. No request/response payloads or customer data.
Dante Ruiz: Draft checklist:
```
1) Confirm NDA + primary contact info
2) Provide rack-level power meter baseline (idle/load)
3) Install redwood-bench v0.3 (container image link provided)
4) Run sample set: caspian_small_prompts.json (30 queries) and caspian_longform.json (10 queries)
5) Capture perf logs and exporter metrics (prometheus text)
6) Upload perf tarball to the S3 path shared with read-only creds
7) Include dmesg and kernel logs, and note any OOMs or panics
```
Sylvia Gomez: Add network egress instructions and SSH account rotation note. Also specify time-sync (NTP) as a hard requirement.
Amy Park: Timeline? Caspian wants alpha results in 3 weeks to align with a product preview. Is that feasible?
Raj Patel: 3 weeks is tight but doable if we ship the bench harness today and the partner runs it within 48h. I can allocate one engineer to triage and one to help on-call for the run.
Amy Park: Ok I'll push an action list to the contact: assign infra engineer (Raj), bench owner (Dante), legal liaisons (Sylvia).
NDA-bot: Reminder: External NDA expires 2026-06-30; auto-notify owners 14 days prior.
Dante Ruiz: I'll prepare the harness and a docker image with exporters. ETA 48h. Will include a minimal runbook and a fallback command: `./run_bench --profile caspian_alpha`.
Sylvia Gomez: I'll draft the telemetry gating doc and the minimal RBAC policy for their test accounts (scoped read-only S3 + write to partner/bench-results).
Amy Park: Perfect. I'll schedule a kickoff call with Caspian for tomorrow 10am PT and share the calendar invite + dial-in. Invite sent to their point: lucas@caspianlabs.com
Raj Patel: I'll be on the call. Also let's add a fallback model variant in the runbook in case their hardware runs out of memory — suggestion: `quantized-compact` for low-RAM runs.
Amy Park: Noted. Post updates here after the call. :thumbsup:
